# Public source fixtures

Information/status/type fixtures are limited to a small subset of HELLO CYCLING stations from the live provider-published GBFS feed observed on 2026-10-02 JST. `baseline.db` preserves that explicit partial snapshot for the read-only full dogfood `stations changes` happy path; it is never an availability guarantee and is not overwritten. Original timestamps are retained. Pricing fixtures retain only the source main/table sections.

GBFS data: HELLO CYCLING / OpenStreet Co., Ltd. via ODPT, normalized/subsetted; CC BY 4.0 selected from the [provider license](https://d1yl7kw204zjxn.cloudfront.net/gbfs/v2/public/hellocycling_gbfs_licence.txt). [GBFS source](https://api-public.odpt.org/api/v4/gbfs/hellocycling/gbfs.json). Pricing: [HELLO CYCLING Tokyo](https://www.hellocycling.jp/price/tokyo/).
